description: This file is a shell script designed to manage a review lifecycle process for components in a software project. It includes functions to start, stop, and clear review dates in metadata YAML files for individual components, as well as utility functions for listing components and generating reports. The script parses command-line arguments to perform these actions and updates metadata accordingly.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Finds and lists all components with metadata.yaml files, excluding certain paths.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and component list.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves the path to a component's metadata.yaml file, with error handling.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Calculates a date after adding a specified number of business days, skipping weekends.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Clears review dates in the specified metadata YAML file.

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Regenerates the RAG status report by calling an external script.
